declaredDifferences: MLX with 4-bit quantized weights instead of the upstream torch bf16 stack; gradients are taken with respect to input embeddings only (weights frozen).
Candidate top-k uses mx.argpartition (unordered tail) with a uniform pick over the same top-k set as torch.topk.

The acquisition criterion is the conjunction of the single-sequence teacher-forced all-match (upstream check_output_with_hard_tokens, on the fixed single-sequence shape of the receipt re-check) and the true greedy continuation from the raw IDs, both checked in-loop at the claiming step; 4-bit quantized logits are evaluation-shape dependent (batch and sequence length), so batched forwards supply candidate losses only.
Free-token initialization and per-step mutation draws use explicit Python random.Random derivations (sampling.py) instead of the process-global RNG, so attempts are deterministic and resumable.
Declared Aleph-side bounds: stepsHardCap caps the step budget after growth; maxAttempts limits the number of GCG attempts.
Only the upstream empty scaffold is declared; scaffolded layouts are a future declared extension.
